The $2.4 billion budget shortfall represented approximately 10 to 15% of Washington State’s general fund.
Governor Locke required agency heads to demonstrate how their departments contributed to ten stated public objectives.
Agencies unable to articulate their contribution to the state’s mission were shut down under Governor Locke’s leadership.
The 'Yellow Pages Test' evaluated whether private sector businesses provided equivalent services to state agencies.
When private sector providers existed and performed efficiently, state functions were transferred to the private sector.
New Zealand’s government reduced its size by 66% and decreased its share of GDP from 44% to 27% during reforms led by Maurice McTeague.
In New Zealand, the Department of Transportation reduced staff from 5,600 to 53 employees.
Maurice McTeague implemented performance-based contracts for government agency heads with five-year terms and renewal based on performance.

assumptions.text: Government efficiency improves when agencies must prove their value to the public rather than receive automatic funding.

Fiscal discipline requires eliminating unnecessary government programs regardless of political consequences or opposition.

Leadership effectiveness is enhanced when decision-makers are insulated from electoral cycles and partisan pressures.
